entries.en: uncertain; wind-related (cf. 'viento' in next entry), headword reading doubtful
entries.notes: 词头第二词 bimo 难解，H 栏疑字（麗/飄）仅据 M 栏 piau 姑取飘义。

entries.en: wind; blowing, drifting wind (uiento = viento)
entries.notes: H 次字在麗/飄间未定，据 M 栏 hong piau 定为飘；词头拼写存疑。

entries.en: shuttle (loom)? — Spanish headword 'formento de dos' does not match, doubtful
entries.notes: H 栏梭与 M 栏 goi tuan 音不对应，西语词头语义亦不合，三栏互证失败。

entries.en: clamp, press (applied to hands and feet); headword prob. tormento (torture instrument)
entries.notes: H 疑字（挟/拫）据 M 栏 guiap 定为挟；词头疑为 tormento。

entries.en: clamp for the feet (foot-press); cf. the next entry 夹脚
entries.notes: M 栏 ngo gi pie 三音节与单字夹不尽对应且末音污损，夹脚义由下条夾腳互证。

entries.en: clamp for the feet; 'id.' = same as the preceding entry

entries.zh: 牛车扒（以牛车拖拽，疑指车裂酷刑）
entries.en: dragging by four carabaos — prob. the ox-cart tearing execution (cf. 车裂)
entries.notes: 西语 de 4 carabaos 与 H 栏牛车相应；扒取拽裂义属推断，词头疑为 tormento。

entries.en: torments and punishments (penas)
entries.notes: H 栏空，M 栏 sem cui 难与西语对应；penas 与 tormentos 常连用故取刑苦义。

entries.en: to turn back, return (tornarse / reducirse)
to turn back, retreat (tornarse atrás)
entries.notes: H 次字印作火而 M 栏 pou 更合后/步，词头疑为 tornarse，故取退回义。

entries.en: to subside, turn away (of anger or breath); verb form 'resuellvarse' illegible
entries.notes: 西语词尾拼写难解（或 revolverse/resollar 之类），取消退义；词头疑为 tornarse。

entries.en: turnsole, heliotrope flower (tornasol)
entries.notes: H/M 栏皆空；词头据本页字母序列（tornero/torno）推为 tornasol。

entries.en: iridescent, shifting color like the turnsole (tornasolado)
entries.notes: 三栏皆空；词头或为 tornasolado，adotro 疑为另条标记。

entries.en: wheelwright, turner (tornero)
cart, coach (carro, coche); also wheel-machine, lathe (torno)
spinning wheel (torno de hilar)
hand-turned wheel; hand spinning wheel
entries.notes: 系上条第二行；R 栏西语注文（妇女亦用之）含难解词 marabayan，非官话对音。

entries.en: press, screw-press / press-wheel (torno de prensa); Chinese side illegible
entries.notes: H 栏残、M 栏残且整行重墨涂改，无从定夺。

entries.en: 〔原件残缺，释义存疑〕
entries.notes: 词头 Torongil 加圈涂改、M 栏两音节均污损，西语注文（直译'烤炉的音乐'）义不可解。

entries.zh: 不佞；口拙、不擅言辞（迟钝）
entries.en: dull, stupid; not knowing how to speak, inarticulate (torpe)
entries.notes: H 次字在倭/倿间未定（倿同佞，义与西语相合），M 栏 pin beng 对应不明。
